title: Sewing groups are consistent
description: A sewing group lists each connection once, no connection belongs to two groups, members of a connected group form a connected graph, and every layer order entry names a participating cut instance exactly once. An importer or editor that cannot express a construction as binary seam connections plus sewing groups without losing meaning reports D2P-SEM-034 (unsupported profile); the conformance runners cannot detect that case, because a conforming document is binary by construction.
